item.name: Mekansm

effects.title: Restore
effects.text: Restores 250 health to allied units in a 1200 radius.

effects.title: Mekansm Aura
effects.text: Grants 2.5 health regeneration to allied units in a 1200 radius.

notes: Restore does not affect units that have been affected by Restore or Guardian Greaves Mend within Mekansm's cooldown.
Multiple instances of Mekansm Aura do not stack.
item.lore: A glowing jewel formed out of assorted parts that somehow fit together perfectly.
